text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Whatever seems to be the matter, Sir Knight?
You appear to be looking a bit unwell.
I surmise the toil of supporting this lively festival has finally caught up with you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はて、
如何なさりましたか喃、
騎士殿や。
何やら面持ちが優れぬ御様子。
華やぐ祝祭の場を支え、
御苦労が溜まった事かと
拝察致しんす。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
If everyone at the venue were to collapse from exhaustion, it would all be for naught.
Thus, allow me to prepare ingredients most effective for restoring vigor.
I believe replenishing your vitality with a strengthening dish would be most fitting.
text_block_list.orig_text:
会場の皆々も、
所労にあてられては元も子もなし。
斯く為れば、
滋養強壮に覿面の食材を此れへ。
精力の増す一品にて、
英気を養って頂くが
宜しきかと存じまする。
